page.overview:
Who is Kwamesa Taramasu?

Kwamesa Taramasu was an Aes Sedai and rebel Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

Kwamesa was dark and slender with a sharp nose. She was of average height, 5'3 1/2 tall., Kwamesa Taramasu|comp}}

She has the habit of peering down her nose at everyone and put great store in ceremony. Some thought her precocious.

There is potentially conflicting infomation on Kwamesa's exact strength in the One Power. The Companion lists her strength level as , which would make her strong for an Aes Sedai. In the books, however, Nynaeve thinks that Reanne Corly "easily equaled Sheriam, say, or Kwamesa or Kiruna. Not many women possessed so much strength". The other three women in that list all have a strength of . Nynaeve may simply be grouping strong sisters together, but she has met several Aes Sedai stronger than Kwamesa to use as examples - all the members of the Salidar Six, for example. Being would make her very strong for an Aes Sedai.
